identity.name: WEBELSOLAR
identity.industry: Solar PV Cell & Module Manufacturing (DCR / domestic-content)

summary.oneLiner: Pure-play DCR solar cell maker that doubled cell capacity to 1.2 GW in FY26, delivered record revenue/EBITDA/PAT and turned net-cash, and is now stepping up the efficiency curve (TOPCon) and the value chain (ingot/wafer) into a structurally short Indian cell market protected by ALMM/DCR mandates.

one-line thesis: Pure-play DCR solar cell maker that doubled cell capacity to 1.2 GW in FY26, delivered record revenue/EBITDA/PAT and turned net-cash, and is now stepping up the efficiency curve (TOPCon) and the value chain (ingot/wafer) into a structurally short Indian cell market protected by ALMM/DCR mandates.
financial scorecard: Highest revenue / EBITDA / PAT in company's 30-year history. CFO INR 255 cr (~84% of PAT) — net-cash surplus achieved.
Net worth doubled INR 278 cr → INR 631 cr. D/E 0.55x → 0.19x. ROCE 66%, ROE 67%. CRISIL BBB+ stable assigned.
Dividend INR 0.25/share recommended. Tax credits fully utilized — FY27 moves to standard tax rate (one-off tailwind ends).
Asset useful life cut: TOPCon to 8 yrs, Mono PERC to 3 yrs (from ~12 yrs) — accelerated depreciation going forward.
guidance (next quarter / fy27 verificati: Approaching full run-rate utilization across all lines in the coming quarter (Q1FY27) vs 90% combined cell util in Q4.
INR 1,161 cr order book expected to be executed within one financial year.
Cell margins expected "healthy with some variability" over next 2-3 yrs; module margins structurally lower.
FY27 effective tax = standard corporate rate (credits exhausted).
order book & pipeline: Confirmed order book INR 1,161 cr (40% cell / 60% module), book-to-bill 1.02x; net order adds of INR 412 cr during the quarter.
Mgmt says it is seeing more orders than reported; "appetite to cater to more" — potential to grow order book meaningfully (analyst floated ~50%).
Not directly tendering for govt orders — sells cells to module makers and DCR modules to solar-pump (KUSUM) players who tender ahead.
100% of book is DCR/ALMM-listed; no non-DCR exposure — already compliant with June-2026 DCR mandate.
segment / subsidiary / capacity: Cell capacity: 600 MW → ~1.2 GW (Line 2 commissioned Sep-2025, via internal accruals, no fund-raise).
Module capacity: 550 MW Mono PERC. ~600 MW of cells consumed captive; surplus ~750 MW cells sold to third parties.
Cell realization ~13–13.5 c/W (softened); module ~22–22.5 c/W; TOPCon DCR currently ~14 c/W.
growth verticals / optionality: TOPCon upgrade of one Mono PERC line: 600→750 MW, targeting >24.5% efficiency (vs 23.3% PERC); commercial start ~Feb-2027.
Integrated 4 GW cell+module facility (Andhra Pradesh) in two phased 2 GW tranches — targeting June-2027 (Phase 1) and ~June-2028 (Phase 2, on TOPCon).
Backward integration into ingot/wafer via Linton MOU; target commissioning ahead of ALMM List 3 deadline (June-2028).
BESS — flagged as natural adjacency, but explicitly exploratory; no commitment.
Future capacity to be kept flexible to insert Back-Contact (BC) equipment later.
margins & cost dynamics: Q4 EBITDA margin compressed QoQ due to (a) record module sales (structurally lower margin than cells) and (b) silver-price spike + sale-price softening on cells.
Despite compression, EBITDA still +86% YoY / +37% QoQ — scale offsetting mix dilution.
ALMM List 2 (mandatory) + PM-KUSUM / PM Surya Ghar demand seen as margin-supportive; pricing decoupled from China (domestic DCR market).
capex / expansion: TOPCon upgrade capex INR 250–270 cr; ~15 days revenue loss on the one upgraded line only (other line runs normally); new equipment installed in adjacent area to minimize downtime.
Andhra Pradesh phase prior-guided ~INR 2,800–3,000 cr; ingot/wafer plant est. INR 300–500 cr/GW (still being quoted).
Falta plant has little/no further expansion headroom — growth must come from new sites.
capital allocation: Funded Phase 2 entirely through internal accruals; net-cash as of Mar-2026.
IREDA net debt ~INR 92 cr; >80% promoter shares pledged against it; repayment + pledge release targeted in "next month or two."
Will use surplus cash first for upcoming capex, then raise "some" debt prudently; emphasis on low leverage.
Promoter non-committal on increasing stake post warrant conversion ("right time we'll take action").
risks & watch-items: Margin compression from rising module mix and volatile silver/input costs.
Working capital build (debtors + inventory) rising — mgmt attributes to volume/mix; says receivables LC-backed by prime banks (watch given industry-wide EPC receivable stress).
Promoter pledge release execution risk (IREDA process).
Andhra Pradesh timeline credibility — zero-to-commercial in ~1 yr for a 2 GW greenfield is aggressive (analyst pushback); mgmt calls it "midway implementation."
Technology obsolescence risk: PERC→TOPCon→Back-Contact; accelerated depreciation signals short asset lives.
Policy dependence: DCR mandate, ALMM List 2/3, KUSUM 2.0 fine print still awaited; SEZ DTA-sale waiver notification pending.
FY27 full tax rate + lower depreciation life are earnings headwinds.
management quality / tone: Confident, disciplined, capital-conservative tone; emphasis on funding growth via internal accruals and minimizing debt. Self-aware on technology cycle risk (phased, optionality-preserving expansion). Candid on margin mix dilution and not over-promising Andhra Pradesh timelines.
non-obvious takeaways: Company is one of few players with more cell than module capacity — net merchant-cell seller into a structurally short Indian cell market (cell ~31 GW vs module ~173 GW installed nameplate).
Announced industry nameplate vastly overstates real supply (most plants run 60–70%); cell ramp is engineering-intensive — supports mgmt's view that oversupply fears are overstated near-term.
TOPCon upgrade lifts watt-peak/cell from ~7.8 Wp to ~9.3 Wp (cell-size G12R 182×210 + efficiency) — meaningful revenue-per-cell uplift independent of price.
Mono PERC retained deliberately — KUSUM/Surya Ghar rooftop demand still favors PERC; line-2 stays PERC for now.
One-off earnings tailwinds (tax credits) ending in FY27 — headline growth will face a tougher base.
qoq change log: Cell capacity now ~1.2 GW (Line 2 commissioned Sep-2025), up from 600 MW; combined cell util 90%, module util reached 80% peak.
TOPCon upgrade of one line now firmly scheduled — commercial start Feb-2027 (capex INR 250–270 cr, 15-day downtime on one line).
Order book updated to INR 1,161 cr (vs ~INR 1,150 cr prior), net adds INR 412 cr; book-to-bill 1.02x.
Turned net-cash; net worth doubled to INR 631 cr; D/E down to 0.19x; CRISIL BBB+ stable assigned during the year.
Prior-quarter customer liquidity/off-take stress now described as resolved — deferred orders executed in Q4.
Asset useful lives revised down (TOPCon 8 yrs, PERC 3 yrs); tax credits fully utilized — FY27 to standard tax.
Andhra Pradesh 2 GW now framed with "greater discipline in sequencing/funding" — firm timelines deferred (targeting June-2027), drew analyst scrutiny vs prior commentary.
New disclosures this quarter: Linton ingot/wafer MOU; BESS flagged as exploratory adjacency; ALMM List 3 (June-2028) wafer mandate as backward-integration trigger.

scorecard.pe_basis: TTM trailing (spec band written for forward P/E)

themes.title: Solar PV cell-to-module manufacturing
themes.need: Solar module/cell manufacturers ride capacity ramp, ALMM/DCR protection and an order-book build-out - a manufacturing thesis distinct from firm-power/FDRE tender economics or merchant storage arbitrage. Q1FY27 quantified the DCR arbitrage: EMMVEE grew revenue 51% to INR 1,555cr with EBITDA margin up to 35.2% and PAT +103% on a 9.9 GW order book, with DCR modules earning INR 8.5-9/W of EBITDA against INR 2-2.5/W for non-DCR - a 3-4x per-watt gap that structurally separates integrated cell makers from module assemblers. The offset is order timing: SWSOLAR booked a record INR 13,000cr unexecuted order value on a landmark USD 560m Egypt win (1,000 MW solar + 600 MWh BESS) yet revenue still fell 10% YoY, and flagged that industry orders concluded only ~INR 6,400cr against the >INR 20,000cr expected, deferred by DCR/module-price uncertainty.
themes.driver: DCR cell/module capacity commissioning and the ALMM List-2 per-watt spread; domestic ordering restarting after two slow quarters (SWSOLAR); order-book conversion.
